name: Resume after change approval (awaiting_approval → executing)
description: The dev loop SHALL NOT start until a human approves the generated change (run.change.approved). This rule is the release side of the first human gate: a run parked in awaiting_approval returns to executing only once run.change.approved is present, at which point dev_from_task becomes eligible for the run's tasks. Without the approval fact the run stays parked — the gate holds. Rule-owned transition (G2). CONTRACT (design D15): group 5's approval adapter MUST stamp run.change.approved on the RUN entity (subject = agent.run.entity-id), or the run never resumes.

on_enter.reason: human approved the change; resuming to develop from the approved tasks
